title: Production prompt cohort catalog and importance-weighted calibration pack curation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Define and produce a repeatable catalog of production prompt cohorts and an associated importance-weighted curation pipeline to generate calibration packs for FP8/INT8 quantization validation. These packs must be representative of live traffic, preserve edge-case failure modes, and be stable enough to detect regressions in accuracy after quantization. Deliverables: (1) cohort catalog with semantic + behavioral metadata per cohort, (2) sampling algorithm that combines recency, token-length strata, predicted sensitivity, and rarity weighting, (3) an automated pack generation pipeline with deterministic seeds and auditable provenance, and (4) stress tests and meta-eval harness to validate pack sensitivity to known model degradations.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort catalog covers at least 12 high-volume and 20 low-volume domains derived from 30 days of production logs and annotated with business tags (e.g., billing, search, chat).

Calibration packs (per-cohort) of N=2k prompts produce stable accuracy deltas (SD < 0.5% across 5 bootstrap resamples) when measuring top-1 token match on baseline vs quantized models for core benchmarks.
Sampling pipeline produces reproducible packs given a git-tagged code version and seed; provenance metadata includes cohort_id, sampling_seed, query_time_range, and transformation steps.
Integration: generated packs can be consumed by the existing quant-eval harness and surface failures in the Redwood Console as a regression alert (link to eval job + dashboard).
Runbook for pack refresh exists: periodicity, triggers (traffic drift >10%, new customer onboarding, new model arch), and owner assignment.
notes: Avoid over-reliance on reservoir sampling alone: our production traffic is heavily skewed by a few customers and automated bots. We will combine three orthogonal signals into a composite weight: (A) recency decay (lambda tuned per domain), (B) inverse-frequency rarity score, and (C) model-sensitivity score estimated by gradient-based importance or proxy perplexity delta. Token-length strata will be enforced to ensure calibration covers short/medium/long contexts. For privacy, all prompts are hashed and stored with reversible access only in secure buckets; PII redaction runs before pack inclusion. Links: PRD: https://confluence.redwood/company/quant-calibration (internal), GH draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-calibration/pull/216, console dashboard mock: https://drive.redwood/company/quant-dashboard.png
